comments: 70f4c8d9: This routine handles the summarization and checking of discharge summaries.
d9a54d1b: Entry point for checking the validity and completion of discharge summaries for a given patient.
e80b5266: Initialize local variable to keep track of process flow.
aee77029: Retrieve parameters from the hospital division settings.
7d4752d2: Exit if no parameters are found.
e0cd6ac8: Set default type for discharge summary if not provided.
33897e25: Check if the discharge summary has been initiated but not completed.
5446a70f: Exit if discharge summary record already exists.
7b552386: Iterate through discharge summaries to find a match with the current parameters.
993c1182: Check for matching discharge summary type and admission number.
79eea9f6: If no existing record is found, proceed to add a new discharge summary.
4fd1a771: End of the check routine.
f53d4995: Subroutine to add a new discharge summary record.
9d79c912: Initialize local variables for the new discharge summary entry.
cb8b184a: Determine service related to the ward.
48147690: Set service value or default if not found.
cd564392: Retrieve the patient's specialty pointer from the admissions.
93254169: Set document related fields based on division parameters.
dd8aac1d: Optionally set additional document field if parameter is set.
35b53276: Set event date and associated ward for the discharge summary.
56cb13c3: File the new discharge summary entry into the database.
87a7e99c: Check if the filing operation was successful.
f941e208: Attempt to lock the new discharge summary record for editing.
561b49a0: Set various fields for the new discharge summary record.
872c1bc2: Save the changes to the discharge summary record.
2dcf4627: Unlock the discharge summary record.
ea0f9b67: Flag the operation as successful and exit.
471fca2e: Subroutine to edit an existing discharge summary.
8f6c290b: Attempt to lock the discharge summary for editing.
4509d56f: Set fields related to the document's verification dates and status.
98e6fbb5: Save the changes and update the document's status.
f6de194c: Unlock the discharge summary after editing.
665ab386: End of the edit routine.
36aaa27d: Subroutine to delete verification dates from a discharge summary.
a75cd078: Attempt to lock the discharge summary for editing.
ebc89854: Clear verification dates from the discharge summary.
0f8d0bb3: Save the changes and update the document's status.
947cf24a: Unlock the discharge summary after deletion.
5b79313f: End of the delete routine.
d226777b: Subroutine to sign and update verification fields of a discharge summary.
d5e9397a: Attempt to lock the discharge summary for signing.
e214345a: Set the signing and verification fields.
b69017fc: Save the changes and update the document's status.
334566d6: Unlock the discharge summary after signing.
3733bbe6: End of the signing routine.
3f8e1d4f: Helper routine to update the status of a discharge summary based on certain fields.
2f3784a3: Initialize local variables for the status update.
7450ebc8: Retrieve the discharge summary's status node.
1d2a3221: Set status to INCOMPLETE if start date is missing.
d443207a: Set status to DICTATED if dictation date is missing.
75942ac9: Set status to TRANSCRIBED if transcription date is missing.
dac04369: Set status to SIGNED NO REVIEW if review is not required.
ff7f009a: Set status to SIGNED if signing date is present.
08ce7333: Set status to REVIEWED if review is required and completed.
8d04382e: Update the discharge summary's status in the database.
59b8510d: End of the status update routine.
a23c4e9a: Subroutine for determining document codes based on service and specialty.
78260e0d: Retrieve the parameter for document code.
cf98c30b: Determine the document code based on service or specialty.
f38c122e: End of the document code subroutine.
